name: open_sub_account
description: Search for a member by ID, then open a new sub-account for them and reach the confirmation screen.

parameters.name: member_id
parameters.description: The member ID to search for.

parameters.name: account_type
parameters.description: Type of sub-account to open: 'Savings', 'Checking', or 'Certificate'.

checkpoint.description: The confirmation page is shown, containing the success banner text.

known_outcomes.name: member_not_found
known_outcomes.description: No member exists with the given member_id.

known_outcomes.name: permission_denied
known_outcomes.description: The member's record is restricted; sub-account cannot be opened.
known_outcomes.detected_by_text: Access denied: this member's record is restricted

known_outcomes.name: deposit_too_low
known_outcomes.description: The initial deposit amount was below the $25 minimum.
known_outcomes.detected_by_text: Initial deposit must be at least $25.00.

known_outcomes.name: invalid_deposit_amount
known_outcomes.description: The initial deposit amount wasn't a valid number.
known_outcomes.detected_by_text: is not a valid dollar amount.

locator_strategy_notes: All targets use accessibility role + accessible name, sourced from the page's ARIA tree. The target app has no ids/classes/test-ids (legacy-style markup), so role+name is the only stable option; form fields were explicitly labeled during target-app development to ensure each has a real accessible name rather than relying on adjacent, unassociated text.
